Note: Clubs with indirect affiliation with [[Asociación del Fútbol Argentino|AFA]] are relegated to the [[Torneo Argentino A]], while clubs directly affiliated face relegation to [[Primera B Metropolitana]]. Clubs with direct affiliation are all from [[Greater Buenos Aires]], with the exception of [[Club Atlético Newell's Old Boys|Newell's]], [[Club Atlético Rosario Central|Rosario Central]], [[Central Córdoba de Rosario|Central Córdoba]] and [[Argentino de Rosario]], all from [[Rosario]], and [[Unión de Santa Fe|Unión]] and [[Colón de Santa Fe|Colón]] from [[Santa Fe, Argentina|Santa Fe]]. ===Tiebreaker 1=== Since [[San Martín de San Juan|San Martín (SJ)]] and [[Racing de Córdoba|Racing (C)]] finished with the same relegation co-efficient at the dividing line, a one-match playoff was held to determine who had to play in the relegation/promotion playoffs. San Martín (SJ) won the playoff so Racing (C) had to play the [[#Relegation playoff|Relegation Playoff Matches]]. {{OneLegStart}} {{OneLegResult|[[Racing de Córdoba|Racing (C)]]||0–1 |'''[[San Martín de San Juan|San Martín (SJ)]]'''}} {{end}} ===Tiebreaker 2=== Since [[Chacarita Juniors]] and [[Defensores de Belgrano]] finished with the same relegation co-efficient at the dividing line, a one-match playoff was held to determine who had to play in the relegation/promotion playoffs and who had to be directly relegated to the [[Primera B Metropolitana]].
